description: Provides real-time internet-wide cyber threat context via the ICHI (Internet Cyber Health Index) — a free, source-transparent daily barometer of global cyber conditions. Tools: get current threat band and score (NORMAL/GUARDED/ELEVATED/HIGH/CRITICAL), retrieve recent critical vulnerability advisories, and check data-source health. No API key required. Disclosed: maintained for ICHI's creator.
name: ICHI MCP Server
